item.title: [−3] US targets mine-laying vessels in the Strait of Hormuz amid blockade disrupting global oil markets
item.description:
Signal: shipping chokepoint disruption. 8 reports from Bhaskar English, Swarajya, Deccan Herald and 5 more. Related: “New Report of Attack on Strait of Hormuz Shipping Fans fears of Threats to Oil Supplies”. Ongoing: also reported on 6 of the previous 7 days (first 30 Oct).

Aviation, shipping & logistics: strong headwind (−3) — Freight, insurance and fuel costs rise

Why it matters: India imports most of its crude and much of its LNG through Hormuz and the Red Sea; disruption lifts oil, freight and insurance costs, widening the import bill and pressuring the rupee.

Market gauges: Fiscal & trade balance −3, Inflation outlook −1, Rupee −1, Equities (Nifty & Sensex) −1

Confidence: high · horizon: weeks

item.title: [+3] Crude crashes below $100: Brent, WTI hit over two-month lows as Trump loses US midterm elections
item.description:
Signal: lower oil prices. 5 reports from The Hindu, Fortune India, The Times of India and 2 more. Related: “Crude Oil Prices Decline as US Midterm Elections Unfold”. Ongoing: also reported on 4 of the previous 7 days (first 31 Oct).

Aviation, shipping & logistics: strong tailwind (+3) — Jet fuel costs fall

Why it matters: Cheaper crude shrinks India's import bill, supports the rupee, eases inflation and lifts margins for fuel marketers, airlines and crude-linked manufacturers.

Market gauges: Fiscal & trade balance +3, Inflation outlook +1, Rupee +1, Equities (Nifty & Sensex) +1

Confidence: high · horizon: weeks

item.title: [+1] Rupee Opens 29 Paise Higher, Brent Crude Falls 1 Pc On Hopes Of Iran War Exit
item.description:
Signal: a stronger rupee. 26 reports from Bloomberg.com, TradingView, Moneycontrol.com and 18 more. Related: “Rupee opens stronger at 94.35 against dollar as crude oil plunges over 8%”. Ongoing: also reported on 3 of the previous 7 days (first 30 Oct).

Aviation, shipping & logistics: mild tailwind (+1) — Dollar costs ease

Why it matters: A stronger rupee lowers import costs and inflation but trims IT and pharma exporters' rupee earnings.

Market gauges: Rupee +3, Inflation outlook +1, Foreign investor flows +1

Confidence: high · horizon: weeks
